$comment: Contract for the DeleteCase server-side command (requirements log row 40). Deployed via the registration console (plugins/OutcomeTesting.Registration). Custom API parameter Type codes: 10=String.

customApi.name: al_DeleteCase
customApi.description: Deletes a case and everything recorded against it, at any stage. Needs the case.delete capability and the case reference typed to confirm; writes an Audit Event naming the case and the reason.

requestParameters.name: TargetId
requestParameters.description: Id of the al_outcomecase to delete.

requestParameters.name: ConfirmReference
requestParameters.description: The case reference, typed by the person deleting it. Refused unless it matches.

requestParameters.name: Reason
requestParameters.description: Why the case is being deleted; kept on the audit event.

requestParameters.name: IdempotencyKey
requestParameters.description: Stable key for the intent; a replay returns the same result.

responseProperties.name: Summary
responseProperties.description: What was deleted, as written to the audit event.

responseProperties.name: AuditEventId
responseProperties.description: Id of the Audit Event written for this command.
